newsitem.title: USA: COMEX copper called to open flat to firmer.
newsitem.headline: COMEX copper called to open flat to firmer.

text.p: COMEX copper futures were seen opening flat to slighly higher Monday, as LME was barely changed in lackluster, overnight trade.
LME stocks fell 475 tonnes to 152,000 tonnes Monday.
COMEX copper stocks rose 678 short tons to 47,066 short tons Friday.
COMEX May copper was seen opening unchanged to up 0.30 cent per pound from Friday's settlement at 106.80 cents, after trading between 107.25 to 106.80 cents in overnight ACCESS trade.

The strike at Escondida copper mine in Chile, which began early Friday, appeared to have little effect on the market. Some 17 percent of the mine workers were involved in the dispute which, the company said, would not affect output.
